Name: Darling Skintones
Author: cherrybeefarm
Description:
I tried to make a mod with new skin-tones for the farmer. The total number of skin tones is limited, but I tried to include a range I didn't often see :")
I wanted to include deeper skin colors since I noticed some people seemed sad that they didn't have the option, I hope this helps make people happy!!
This is my first time making any sort of mod, so feedback is appreciated!!

Content Patcher and it's dependencies are necessary for my mod to work.

To install, please make sure content patcher is up to date. Take the manual download of the mod and unzip it in your mod's folder!

Manifest.Name: Darling Skintones
Manifest.Description: Changes the skintones for the farmer
Manifest.Author: cherrybeefarm
